notes: The analysed quantities come from Pfizer phase 2b and 3 trials conducted in multiple countries, so setting is international rather than US national. view_issues: Table 2 gives 202 preterm births in the RSVpreF arm (trial dosing interval), but the Results text says 201. The Table 2 note says differences were not significant 'as determined by nonoverlapping CIs', yet the compared CIs overlap.
